title: A rigorous hybridization of variational quantum eigensolver with classical neural network
summary: Combining variational quantum process with classical neural learning offers a flexible route to improve ground-state estimation. We establish an integrated framework that connects neural transformations, measurement statistics, and guarantees physical stability through three requirements: self-contained training, polynomial resource scaling, and variational consistency. Its constructive realization, termed \emph{unitary variational quantum-neural hybrid eigensolver}~(U-VQNHE), couples a variational quantum circuit to a neural phase function through norm-preserving post-processing.
